title: Binance Reopens Withdrawals as Hack Recovery Enters Second Week
summary: Bitcoin Magazine Binance Reopens Withdrawals as Hack Recovery Enters Second Week Binance has reopened withdrawals after its $6.3 billion North Korea hack, covered 95% of losses, and has reserves for the remaining 5%, with post-mortem reviews to stay open. This post Binance Reopens Withdrawals as Hack Recovery Enters Second Week first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .
